steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Press play on any card. Every preview is free.

steps.title: Choose and pay
steps.text: Leave your name and where to send it, then pay with the method you choose.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Once your payment is confirmed, the full recording arrives within {time}.

faq.a: The full recording as an audio file, sent to the email or messenger you choose.
Usually within {time} after your payment is confirmed.

faq.q: What is a custom made recording?
faq.a: A recording made just for you. After you order, you tell me what you'd like to hear and we agree on the details before I record.

faq.q: Can I share or resell a recording?
faq.a: Recordings are for personal listening only. Please don't share, publish or resell them.
Write to me on Instagram, Telegram or WhatsApp and mention your order number.
